designationHistory.name: Columbia White Tailed Deer Sanctuary
designationHistory.indexText: The Fish and Wildlife Service bought an 845-acre first parcel in December 1971, establishing a sanctuary for the endangered Columbian white-tailed deer along the lower Columbia River.

authority.citation: Administrative establishment by land purchase (U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service)

designationHistory.note: FWS CCP: first parcel bought December 1971 as the 'Columbia White Tailed Deer Sanctuary'; renamed Columbian White-tailed Deer National Wildlife Refuge by July 1972. The later renaming for Representative Julia Butler Hansen was not verified.

sources.name: FWS ServCat: Lewis and Clark NWR and Julia Butler Hansen Refuge CCP/EIS (2010)
